newsitem.title: USA: Seagram's Universal trims music label.
newsitem.headline: Seagram's Universal trims music label.

text.p: Seagram Co. Ltd.'s Universal Music Group said on Monday it cut back its Uptown Records black music label and gave its president, Heavy D, a new role.

Heavy D, a rap musician whose real name is Dwight Myers, has been named senior vice-president of the Universal Music Group, a title that would give him wider responsibilities on a more creative level, a statement said.

However Uptown, where Myers had served as president since January 1996, has fired about nine of its 16 employees. Their roles will be carried out at Universal Music. The statement said Uptown would remain "primarily a creative source," with a roster including Soul 4 Real, Monifah and the Lost Boys.
